recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white line art illustration featuring a young child playing an acoustic guitar, surrounded by punk-inspired heraldic elements and arched typography on a speckled background.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by a bottom-weighted typographic arc
Top-right heraldic crest balances the diagonal guitar neck
Stipple texture provides depth to the flat white negative space
coreInvariants: Strict black and white color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central full-body figure, occupying approximately 60% of vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The arched text at the bottom serves as a heavy base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the child's face, follows the guitar neck upward to the crest, then down the body to the bottom arc.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space filled with fine black stippling to simulate vintage print quality.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for outlines and fills

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and hand-drawn sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Bottom arc uses blocky, high-contrast slab serifs
Sash text uses organic, uneven hand-drawn capitals
Crest text uses condensed, geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the bottom arc are warped to follow a concave curve
Sash lettering follows the perspective of the fabric fold
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact block display paired with casual, raw hand-lettering for a DIY punk feel.

preserve: Hand-drawn feel of the sash text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and slab-serif nature of the bottom arc.
Best for the sash text to maintain the organic, hand-drawn look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white line art illustration of a young boy with a bowl cut playing a small acoustic guitar. Include a punk-style heraldic crest in the top right and a sash across his waist. The background should be white with a fine black stipple/noise texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold slab-serif uppercase text in a concave arc at the bottom, flanked by stylized black wings. Add hand-drawn style uppercase text onto the sash following its curvature.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Does the bottom text follow a clear concave arc?
Is the background textured with stipple noise?
Are the line weights consistent across the character and objects?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the child
Specific wording on the sash and arc
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no gray tones are present
Check that text is legible despite the warp
Verify the guitar strings are rendered as distinct lines
Confirm the stipple texture doesn't obscure the main subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Child Musician] + [Style: Punk Line Art] + [Texture: Stipple Noise] + [Layout: Arched Bottom Typography] + [Element: Heraldic Crest].
